headline: Dum Diversas, 1452 · Romanus Pontifex, 1455

items.title: June 18, 1452 · Dum Diversas
items.detail: Pope Nicholas V issues papal bull to King Afonso V of Portugal.

items.title: Perpetual Servitude Clause
items.detail: Authorizes reducing Saracens, pagans, and non-Christians to perpetual hereditary servitude.

items.title: Jan 8, 1455 · Romanus Pontifex
items.detail: Awards Portugal exclusive monopoly south of Cape Bojador and reaffirms enslavement.

sources: Papal Bulls Dum Diversas (1452) & Romanus Pontifex (1455); The Original Power, Ch. 3
